name: amos-agentops-observability-rscf-agent
description: Read/audit-oriented AMOS agent for trace topology, privacy-aware telemetry, durable transport state, OTLP projections, backend read-back, missingness, and evidence receipts.

capabilities.name: agentops_observability.trace_audit
capabilities.description: Audit trace topology, lifecycle and receipt integrity.

capabilities.name: agentops_observability.privacy_audit
capabilities.description: Audit capture mode, redaction, persisted fields and telemetry missingness.

capabilities.name: agentops_observability.transport_audit
capabilities.description: Audit OTLP encoding, durable outbox state, retry classification, ambiguous delivery and transport receipts.

capabilities.name: agentops_observability.roundtrip_audit
capabilities.description: Audit backend read-back against exact trace, run, build, span topology and required AMOS attributes.

capabilities.name: agentops_observability.effect_observation
capabilities.description: Inspect observed effect states without treating telemetry as effect authorization.
